methodologyNotes: Roster of 12 under-desk walking pads and 2-in-1 folding desk treadmills (not full running treadmills). Each entry independently re-verified on 2026-06-19 against manufacturer product pages (kingsmith.com, walkingpad.com, speraxwalkingpad.com, urevo.com, egofitwalker.com, deerruntreadmill.com, mobvoi.com, superuntreadmill.com), major retail listings (Walmart, Target, Best Buy, Amazon), and expert reviews (Consumer Reports, TechRadar, Jay's Home Gym, Live Science, Garage Gym Reviews). Speeds in mph, weights in lb, belt dimensions length x width in inches. Booleans: true = confirmed yes, false = confirmed no. priceUsd reflects published US MSRP / official list price for the EXACT named config; sale/promo prices noted in priceNote. NULL is used wherever a value could not be corroborated. accessedAt 2026-06-19.
